authorityReview.evidence: The selected payable zero-argument deposit() is inherited from UserDepositManager: it calls _deposit(msg.sender), which rejects zero msg.value, accounts the incoming ETH, and calls River's fixed _onDeposit. River's override applies the protocol slashing-containment guard before forwarding to the inherited accounting path. _onDeposit calls SharesManagerV1._mintShares(msg.sender, msg.value), then invokes the protocol allowlist's onlyAllowed(caller, DEPOSIT_MASK). Because the selected method sets _recipient == _depositor == msg.sender, the recipient-denial/transfer branch is not entered; the fixed share accounting mints/credits the caller. This admits only the source-qualified fixed protocol call, not arbitrary target/callback/calldata. Protocol allowlist/compliance, pause/slashing mode, zero ETH, share accounting/exchange, and governance conditions may revert. The pinned repository River source differs from address-bound verified River source; no equivalence is asserted. Dated deployment and Etherscan association do not establish current proxy storage/runtime, liquidity, funding, or outcome. No platform amount, caller allowlist, receiver, feed, balance, or financial-safety gate is added; caller-only share minting is protocol behavior, not a platform recipient restriction. depositAndTransfer, receive/fallback, validator, withdrawal queue, admin, and all other initial-snapshot methods are excluded.
